launcher-capability.description: Capability for the IRIS Launcher window. It loads launcher/index.html from the app's OWN origin in both profiles — proxied to the Vite server by Next in dev, served from the bundle in a package — so there is no `remote` block and no remote-origin IPC restriction. It used to be a WebviewUrl::External on :8080, which rendered fine and silently dropped every invoke().

wings-capability.description: Capability for wings detached into their own windows. Each runs the same frontend as the widget, on the same origin (WebviewUrl::App, never External), and drives the same shared WS client — so it needs the widget's permissions and no `remote` block.
